findings.control: git() runs with -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null, no system config, no GIT_* from the parent, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; checkout_guard refuses filter programs (also in submodule configs), a redirected work tree and hidden index entries
findings.title: Release target check ran a target checkout's own Git programs (core.fsmonitor, filter drivers, index hooks) and could be redirected by core.worktree, assume-unchanged bits or inherited GIT_* variables

findings.control: governor.check_payload runs before authorization for every secrets:none action; the deny is audited by rule name
findings.title: Control plane did not enforce secrets:none: a credential-shaped payload reached the engine

findings.control: O_NOFOLLOW open relative to the directory descriptor of a caller-owned mode 0700 state dir, then fstat: regular, caller-owned, one link, no group/other bits (rechecked under the lock); verify_audit opens the same way
findings.title: Governor audit log was appended although it was readable by others, hard-linked to another file, foreign-owned, or in a directory others can write

findings.control: _write refuses a GAIE_HOME not owned by the caller or writable by group/others
findings.title: Private project registry was written into a GAIE_HOME that another user owns or can write

findings.control: _context refuses an existing state directory that is not caller-owned mode 0700 before the governor or any engine
findings.title: A state directory open to others was refused only after the engine had written state

findings.control: security_audit.audit_anchor / verify_audit_anchor; the owner must keep the anchor outside the state directory

findings.control: environment reduced to PATH/HOME/TMPDIR, loopback-only socket guard, timeouts, process-group kill; fix: run the driver through governor.sandbox_run (owner: self-healing)
findings.title: Self-healing runs target repository code through detectors.Sandbox, a Python-level guard without the governor's OS sandbox: files the user can read stay readable

findings.control: fix: resolve and check before mkdir, create with mode 0o700 (owner: cinematic)

findings.control: the router launches no Git; workspace_policy._git runs with fsmonitor and the untracked cache off, no system or global config, a fixed environment without inherited GIT_* variables and GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; a write scope refuses configs with includes, URL rewrites, filters or core.hooksPath
findings.title: Router workspace probe ran git in a workspace without the hardening flags

findings.control: O_NOFOLLOW, 0600 on create, 0700 directories; fix: reuse orchestration._open_private (owner: memory)
